column1: # Resources the W3C server negotiates over language, recorded 2026-10-10
# Columns: resource IRI, Content-Language of the variant, the variant's
# The first row of a resource is the variant the server sends when the
# request names no language or none that matches (measured: no header,
# `*`, `fr` and `de;q=0, en;q=0` all received the `en` variant).
# The runner reads the agent's language range against these rows by
# RFC 4647 section 3.4 (Lookup), then follows RFC 9110 section 12.5.4:
# with no match the server sends its default variant, not an error.
